name: Feedback
author: modpunk (omarchy.fans)
description: Report bugs and ideas about anything on your Omarchy desktop in one keypress: a screenshot you can mark up, the events that led up to it (never typed text) and an optional screen replay, filed in a local issue list. Hand issues to Rix, your coding agent or the author, and replay or export them as PDF or Markdown from a local web viewer.

barWidget.description: Bug chip: your feedback issues, report an issue, arm the screen replay, and hand issues to Rix, your coding agent, or the author.
